summary: The group has 243 rows (237 regular files and 6 symlinks): 20 in odm_a and 223 in vendor_a. It holds the remote-processor firmware and runtime set: Hexagon DSP6 root images for ADSP and CDSP (split .mdt plus .bNN segments), the FastRPC user daemons (adsprpcd, cdsprpcd) and DSP-side shell and skel libraries, the XRA audio-pipeline CAPI modules with JSON configs and tuning blobs, an EVA Xtensa image, an SPSS ARM image, the QCA6490 WLAN firmware with board-data ELFs, message catalogs and an ini config, AArch64 secure-app images with servreg JSON configs, ODM microcontroller images (SyncBoss, SantanaManager, MCU tar bundles with unwind ELFs), PDFU update packages and an EFM8 image. The mounted ueventd.rc, vendor_file_contexts, vendor_sepolicy.cil and init .rc files confirm the firmware search paths, the labels for /vendor/bin/adsprpcd and /vendor/bin/cdsprpcd, the three remoteproc instances (spss, adsp, cdsp) and the adsprpcd and cdsprpcd init services. Most firmware image names are not referenced by name in any mounted init or SELinux text file.
